title: Investor Profit-Only Withdrawal While Holding Open Trade Tickets
precondition: Sub-account balance = $12,000 ($2,000 realized profit); 1 open trade.
expected: $2,000 debited from cash; free margin verified; open child ticket preserved safely.
coverage_note: Requires investor payment/withdrawal, lockup, reversal, or emergency LPOA workflow. Admin Set balance is not a substitute.
